## Variables

### BOOT\_CHECK\_VERSION

```ts
const BOOT_CHECK_VERSION: "boot-page-v2" = "boot-page-v2";
```

The version of this check's judgement. A recorded result is reused only for the
same version; changing what counts as mounted, or what is recordable as a
verdict, bumps it. v2: a host or transport failure (the parent page not loading,
a dropped browser) is never a verdict.

## Functions

### checkBootPage()

```ts
function checkBootPage(sessions, target): Promise<BootPageResult>;
```

Open one candidate's pinned boot page on a dedicated provider session, wait for
its UI to mount, and confirm the session closed. Cleanup uncertainty outranks
every other outcome.
